component.name: Misuc
component.summary: Multi-track MIDI sequencer and audio workstation

description.p: Misuc is a digital audio workstation built around the pattern workflow: a full-range piano roll with snap quantise, an arrangement playlist, and a live mixer with buses and per-track FX chains (LV2 hosting on Linux).
Quality-of-life is part of the contract: session autosaves you can actually recover from, 50-step undo/redo, sample-accurate rendering, and a live PipeWire engine on Linux (WASAPI on Windows).

Installer refresh: the Windows installer now carries the full runtime (Qt + MSVC redist + codec DLLs) and a themed NSIS wizard; the Debian package gained proper maintainer scripts and AppStream metadata.
First Windows-capable release. Installer issues were reported on real machines and fixed in 0.3.1.
